breaking.member: UI CSS white-space, white-space-collapse, tab-size and text-wrap
breaking.change:
Text change: a text's white space is processed from its computed white-space at build time, for bound text ({$value}, {expr}) and text with inline elements as for literal text. Before, the parser collapsed every text's spaces and line breaks HTML's way unless it was plain literal text, so pre, pre-line, pre-wrap, break-spaces and tab-size did nothing to a bound string, and a bound string under normal kept its runs of spaces and newlines as written. A
stays a line break under every value.
breaking.fix: A text that relied on a bound string's newlines or repeated spaces showing under the default white-space gives the element `white-space: pre-line` (newlines) or `white-space: pre-wrap` (spaces and newlines).
